source.title: Fine Structure Constant Variation from a Late Phase Transition
source.read_channel: web PDF extraction; version confirmed on abstract and PDF first page
source.read_scope: Equations (2)–(3) on numbered pp.1–2 / PDF pp.2–3, plus nearby discussion and radiative/energy caveats. Not a full model review.
source.used_for: Dependence of low-energy alpha on moving charged-mass thresholds at fixed UV coupling.
source.not_used_for: No adoption of the source historical observational claim, phase transition model or historical allowed parameter regions.

claim_intent_manifest.claim: Under a new charged-field mass matching and fixed UV boundary, the one-loop threshold formula transfers an inverse-log-square mass-squared response into a leading inverse-log-square alpha response.
negative_constraints: Charged field, physical mass matching and fixed UV input remain assumptions.
A one-loop formula is not an all-orders prediction.
Radiative potential and feedback may change the clock trajectory.
No claim that the existing real scalar lattice has already derived a charged quantum field.
No identification of RG energy with cosmic time.
